context_requirements: Functional HIF1A protein and intact oxygen-sensing pathway (PHD/VHL)
Aerobic conditions or normoxia to allow drug-induced HIF stabilisation
Expression of HIF1A and its transcriptional coactivators (ARNT, CBP/p300)
Cell lines with active HIF-dependent metabolic and angiogenic programs
falsifiers: No induction of canonical HIF target genes (e.g., BNIP3, DDIT4, HMOX1) at 6 h or 24 h in any responsive line
Strong upregulation of HIF targets in all nine lines with equal magnitude, contradicting known lineage-specific differences
Lack of dose-dependent or time-dependent changes in HIF target genes
No correlation between HIF1A expression levels and transcriptional response
